cause: Flutter closes the arena on pointer-down and defaults a singleton arena to its sole member; the accepted scroll drag consumes the first move. Incular has no close/default-singleton path, so its DragStartBehavior::Start threshold branch drops that first 40 px move.
impact: Every later sampled scroll offset remains 40 px apart; settled offsets at 1568 ms are 1193.7479 vs 1153.7479.
title: Singleton scroll arena drops the first drag move
fix_direction: Mirror Flutter close-after-down and singleton default-winner behavior while retaining arbitration for competing members.

cause: Flutter's dedicated DoubleTapGestureRecognizer stores the first tap independently. Incular records last_tap only inside the regular tap/tap-up/tap-cancel callback branch; with only on_double_tap, the first pointer-up rejects without saving the first tap.
impact: GestureDetector configured with onDoubleTap alone never fires its callback in Incular.
title: Double-tap-only detector does not retain the first tap
fix_direction: Track first-tap state independently from onTap callbacks, matching Flutter's separate recognizer lifecycle.

cause: Flutter invokes onLongPress together with onLongPressStart when the deadline expires. Incular's poll action emits LongPressStart only; its separate LongPress action dispatching on_long_press is returned from pointer-up handling.
impact: The public onLongPress callback is delayed until pointer-up; while the pointer remains down after the timeout, Incular has only fired onLongPressStart.
title: onLongPress fires on release instead of at the deadline
fix_direction: Dispatch onLongPress at the deadline alongside onLongPressStart; keep onLongPressEnd at release.

cause: Flutter's sole scale recognizer wins the arena closed after pointer-down and acceptGesture starts a possible scale immediately. Incular has no singleton default arena winner and waits for focal-point movement to cross pan slop.
impact: Scale onStart timing differs on touch-down even for a one-pointer scale gesture; downstream consumers initialize transforms at different times.

first_divergence.event_state: after pointer-down and before first move

title: Single-pointer scale starts at different times
fix_direction: Resolve singleton arenas on pointer-down and recheck scale start and competing drag behavior.
additional_scenario: gestures__scale__two_pointer_pinch: frame 3 scale Flutter 1.5 vs Incular 1.0; frame 4 1.8333 vs 1.0

cause: Flutter defaults LongPressDraggable.delay to kLongPressTimeout and uses DelayedMultiDragGestureRecognizer. Incular's LongPressDraggable conversion constructs a plain Draggable and has no delay parameter.
impact: LongPressDraggable can begin a drag without Flutter's 500 ms hold, changing drag-target acceptance and gesture arbitration.
title: LongPressDraggable maps to immediate Draggable
runtime_status: open; test twin could not be accepted because Flutter FrameHarness has no Overlay ancestor required by LongPressDraggable
fix_direction: Carry delayed-start behavior through the Incular drag source and test with an Overlay-enabled frame harness.
